meta.name: add-clidash
meta.description: Add clidash — a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard that derives its tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that lists resources as JSON. Ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles), plus message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer for group skills/CLAUDE.md/profiles.

copy.tagline: 将任意 JSON 输出 CLI 转为实时 Web 仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有输出 JSON 的 CLI 工具，想快速生成 Web 仪表盘
copy.tagline_en: Turn any JSON-output CLI into a live web dashboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a CLI that outputs JSON and want a quick web dashboard

howto.what: 装好后会多一个只读的本地网页仪表盘:启动服务后,它把能以 JSON 列出资源的 CLI(ncl、docker 等)在运行时渲染成标签页和表格,并附带 NanoClaw 的 Agents 概览、消息活动图表、日志尾巴和只读文件查看器。
howto.when: 当你想给某个能以 JSON 列出资源的 CLI(如 ncl、docker 等)搭一个只读的网页仪表盘并在本地查看时使用;它默认只绑定 127.0.0.1。

say.text: 把 clidash 装进 tools/clidash 并启动它
say.note: 复制目录、生成配置后运行 node server.js

say.text: 在 clidash 配置里再加一个 docker 的标签页
让 clidash 只绑内网 IP,不要绑公网
say.note: 通过 BIND 环境变量或配置里的 bind

howto.what_en: clidash is a read-only local web dashboard that turns any CLI listing resources as JSON (ncl, docker, etc.) into tabs and tables at runtime, plus NanoClaw Agents overview, activity charts, log tail and a read-only file viewer.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want a read-only web view over a CLI that lists resources as JSON (ncl, docker, etc.), viewed locally; it binds 127.0.0.1 by default.

say_en.text: Install clidash into tools/clidash and start it
say_en.note: Copies the dir, makes config, runs node server.js

say_en.text: Add a docker tab in the clidash config
say_en.note: Edit clidash.config.json only, no code changes

say_en.text: Bind clidash to a private tailnet IP, not public
say_en.note: Set BIND or bind in the config
